row:
Hello people! 
This is Adhip Nadkarni for Movement Science Welcome to this channel. I have created these videos for sharing and spreading my biomechanical knowledge. 
More importantly, I aim to portray this subject's fundamental relationship with physiotherapy and the world that surrounds us through my videos. 
The fascination on my face when someone explains a new concept is unparalleled. 
Its truly fulfilling when I get the chance to apply this knowledge in clinical practice. 
I hope to make this a fun learning experience as I take you on this rewarding journey.

Thank You :)
